answer: Each identity keeps one garden beehive, locking an 80-credit bond. A lantern tag on the hive carries its serial. Each epoch the keeper files frame count and honey weight; an auditor recounts frames and recomputes yield from the glacier bloom table, allowing 5 percent error. First hive 38 credits, kth 38 plus 6 times k minus 1, 1000th 6032, 1000 fakes 3035000 plus 80000 locked, no shared hive. A rented-hive ring fails: a borrowed tag serial belongs to another garden, so count and weight mismatch and burn the bond. An honest keeper pays 38 once, recovering the bond after a clean epoch.
